BiblicalUsage: Zophar asks whether by searching we can find out God, or find out the Almighty unto perfection. Job says man sets an end to darkness, and searches out all perfection. David says he hates God's enemies with perfect hatred, and counts them his enemies, and the wall is built from the house of Eliashib to the turning of the wall, to its completion. The word is completion, the extremity, the end: the perfection of God, the end of darkness, and the end of a wall.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that perfection belongs to God before it belongs to anyone else. I believe Zophar's question is the right one: I cannot find out the Almighty unto perfection, and the searching itself is part of worship. What I can do is hate what He hates, and build what He has given me to build, to its end.
